entries.aiSummary: Today's tape skews heavily toward healthcare/biotech (VIVS, POAS, MRKR) and China microcaps (CHSN, RAYA, ELOG, INHD) with real catalysts (CONTRACT, PHASE-2, ACQUISITION) mixed against zero-news sympathy runs, creating mixed signal quality for the playbook's strict standards. Float distribution clusters aggressively at sub-5M (RAYA 0.52M, POAS 1.28M, INHD 2.4M, CHSN 2.42M, MPU 3.15M, SEAT 4.4M) with only VIVS and MRKR pushing into the 16-20M range, ideal for momentum compression but raising liquidity risk on hard reversals. Session HODs dominated afternoon and morning prints (VIVS 169%, CHSN 144%, SEAT 105%, POAS 106% all clearing intraday), signaling true hot-cycle continuation rather than premarket trap fades, though RAYA's 62% premarket spike with 68% afternoon fade and TDTH's 76% morning spike with 69% fade inject caution on sustainability. This framework reads as HOT for intraday runners with real biotech/deal flow backing (VIVS, SEAT, MRKR eligible A-range), but the heavy China no-news concentration (CHSN, RAYA, MPU, ELOG) and offering dilution (TDTH, ELOG) pull the overall tape temperature to neutral-to-slightly-hot—playbook should hunt VIVS and SEAT hard on dips while treating China sympathy names as volatile liquidation vectors into EOD.
